A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same survey and provide readable text, figures, tables and references. All pages were inspected; neither PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: V1 presents a conceptual taxonomy, illustrative diagrams and cited benchmark metadata, without original experimental, simulation, user-study or measured data-analysis results.

after.justification: Figure 2 reports relative keyword occurrence frequencies across the surveyed papers. This constitutes a small original descriptive data analysis, although its counting procedure is not documented. No original agent experiments are reported.

M1.justification: The dual-perspective taxonomy and descriptions of existing agent procedures are retained. V2's diagnostic, planning and reflection proposals are future research directions, not implemented changes to a proposed algorithm or model.

E1.justification: The benchmark inventory, source domains and task descriptions are unchanged between v1 Table 4 and v2 Table 5. Neither version trains or evaluates agents on these benchmarks; the new literature keyword summary does not expand training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates a proposed system against baselines. V2 Table 3 qualitatively compares the architectural categories already discussed in v1, rather than introducing evaluated comparison methods.

E3.justification: No experimental splits, evaluation metrics, budgets, model configurations or testing procedures are introduced or revised. The benchmark critique and proposed uncertainty-aware planning are discussion, not implemented evaluation protocols.

E4.justification: V2 adds a descriptive supplementary analysis of concept frequency in the surveyed literature through Figure 2. No ablations, measured robustness tests or empirical error studies are added; the new failure-mode discussions are interpretive.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Section 6.2's new uncertainty-aware planning proposal concerns agent behavior, not statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: V2 Figure 2 newly reports relative keyword frequencies, with RAG, retrieval and multi-agent concepts prominently represented. Benchmark task counts and existing tabulated attributes remain unchanged, and no agent performance scores are added or revised.

T1.justification: Neither version develops formal mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorems or proofs. V2's additional conceptual arguments and qualitative ratings do not introduce formal theory.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same two contributions: a comprehensive survey and a framework connecting agent design with data science workflows. The new research questions articulate this existing scope.

C2.justification: V2 substantially expands architectural reliability, coordination-cost and applicability tradeoffs in Section 3.1 and Table 3, and adds benchmark limitations in Section 5. Section 6 replaces trainable-architecture and multimodal priorities with data-centric diagnostics and uncertainty-aware planning, while refocusing reflection on pipeline-level error propagation.

D1.justification: No implementation settings, hardware information, hyperparameters, code release or data-access instructions are added or revised. The new keyword cloud and trade-off table provide no reproducible counting or rating procedure.

R1.justification: The rewritten future-work section removes citations and reference entries for TextGrad, Automated Design of Agentic Systems, and Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail? The related-work section and the survey's main differentiation from earlier surveys remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 reorganizes the introduction around five research questions, rewrites Section 3's motivation, adds evaluative paragraphs for each agent category, and substantially rewrites Sections 5 and 6. These changes substantially alter the narrative toward reliability and limitations, while preserving the overall section order.

P2.justification: V2 adds the keyword cloud and architectural trade-off table, reformats the author block and typography, and adjusts figure and table placement. Existing diagrams are retained and renumbered; the unchanged benchmark table moves after the conclusion.

improvement.justification: V2 offers clearer research questions and more practical architectural and benchmark guidance. However, its revised limitations introduce internal inconsistencies: Section 6.3 says existing reflection operates only at the step level and cannot revisit earlier stages, despite retained descriptions of traceback and global reflection in Sections 3.2.3 and 3.4.2. V1's corresponding discussion was more qualified. These gains in guidance coexist with weakened consistency, preventing a reliable net quality judgment.
